sources.title: SELF change-dependency lists
sources.version_or_date: OOPSLA October 1989; Lisp and Symbolic Computation June 1991
sources.confirmed: SELF uses implementation-level maps to organize object layouts and customize methods, and dependency lists invalidate compiled methods after programming changes.
sources.limits: Requires complete mutation interception, dependency storage, and handling for active compiled frames. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: SELF polymorphic inline caches
sources.confirmed: Polymorphic inline caches retain multiple lookup results per call site and collect observed receiver-type information for adaptive compilation.
sources.limits: PICs alone do not detect rebinding: entries need validity guards, and many states increase test or miss costs. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: Java SwitchPoint
sources.confirmed: A switch point selects optimized or fallback method handles and permanently invalidates all dependent guards; invalidation and direct state queries may be expensive, with batching recommended.
sources.limits: This JVM API is a design analogue; synchronization can be costly and renewed speculation needs a fresh switch point. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: efficiently-implementing-python-objects-3838329944323946932.html
sources.confirmed: PyPy shares immutable maps describing instance keys, replaces a map when shape changes, stores values separately, and falls back to a general dictionary for unsupported dictionary keys; JIT compilation can eliminate traversal of immutable map chains.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.sections_read: Dictionary Optimizations; Method Caching; Special Bytecodes
sources.confirmed: The live documentation describes type-version method-cache keys, invalidation when a type or base changes, and an instance-shadowing condition for reuse.

sources.title: Linux sequence counters
sources.sections_read: Introduction; seqcount_t; sequential-lock read/write and retry examples
sources.confirmed: Sequence counters detect overlapping mutations with before/after reads and retries; writers require serialization, and pointer lifetime is explicitly outside the mechanism's safety guarantee.
sources.limits: This is a synchronization analogue; writers need serialization, pointer lifetimes need protection, and retries may dominate. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: JavaScriptCore property and global watchpoints
sources.sections_read: Publication date; Watchpoints; Watchpoints and Invalidation (find inspection)
sources.confirmed: Watchpoints notify optimized code when properties, structures, or global-variable mutability change; invalidation removes optimized entry paths and redirects execution through on-stack replacement. The described source is dated 29 July 2020.
sources.limits: This evidence is from 2020; transfer requires complete write hooks and safe deoptimization of active code. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: PyPy module cell dictionaries
sources.sections_read: withcelldict option; requirements; release-version and copyright footer
sources.confirmed: The mirrored PyPy project documentation says module cell dictionaries aid JIT global lookups, are not helpful without a JIT, and require honor__builtins__ to be false.
sources.limits: Documentation requires a JIT and honor__builtins__=False; implementation-source retrieval failed, leaving the mutation-validation algorithm unverified. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C12.json.

sources.title: PyPy type-version method cache
sources.version_or_date: PyPy 2.6.0 / release-2.6.x; companion configuration page in this snapshot bears copyright 2015
sources.confirmed: This historical PyPy project documentation snapshot describes a cache keyed by lookup name, call site, and a type version that changes with type/base mutation, subject to instance shadowing.
sources.limits: Instance shadowing still needs checking; globals and builtins require coverage of their distinct mutation paths.
